title: Amazingly useful and easy to use HOWEVER

title: Your latest update broke birthday notifications
body:
Since your last update, i now get birthday notifications with 1 week in advance, as well as on the actual birthday day, with no option to turn any of these 2 notifications off. It is extremely annoying. There should be an option to turn either of them off.
The app also crashes every time you try to set a location on an event. After the first 2 letters, right when the auto suggestions should appear, the app hangs. Do you even test your code before releasing?
